name: Feature Bento — Crestline
html:
Zero configuration. Seamless deployments.

Crestline provides everything you need to host your frontend, from the first commit to your busiest traffic day.

Infinite scalability

Every layer of your infrastructure scales up and down automatically, from ingress to storage and compute.

Intelligent edge caching

The edge preserves copies of critical assets and tolerates outages, so caching stays correct without manual purging.

Observability as priority

Real-time logs, one-click integrations, and built-in analytics mean you never have to forgo visibility.

Atomic deploys

Every release is immutable, and domains act as pointers. Reverting is a single, instant swap.

Immutable asset preservation

Every past build stays reachable, including its JS, CSS, and other assets, so old links never quietly break.

Always fast and online

Deploying and reverting never slows or interrupts existing traffic, so visitors never see an error page.

Automatic failover

Traffic reroutes the instant a region has trouble, so user requests never slow down or see errors.

Multi-region execution

Functions run close to your users across many regions, cutting latency without any extra configuration.

Image optimization

Every image is resized, compressed, and served in the best format for each visitor automatically.

name: FAQ — Hoist
html:
Questions worth asking upfront

Does Hoist support staging environments?

Yes — every pull request gets its own disposable preview environment automatically, promoted to production when you're ready.

How do I size my instances?

You don't. Hoist scales vertically to meet demand as it changes. Need horizontal scale instead? Just add a replica.

Can I run background workers?

Yes — a worker is just a service with no exposed port. Attach a domain later if you decide you want it public.

What happens to my data if I downgrade?

Nothing is deleted. Volumes and databases stay attached to your project; only compute limits change.

Is there a free trial?

Yes. The Free plan doesn't expire and includes enough usage credit to run a small project indefinitely.

name: FAQ — Keel
html:
Frequently asked questions

  • How does Keel secure my code?

    All code is encrypted with TLS in transit and AES-256 at rest, with Privacy Mode enforced by default for Business and Enterprise.

  • Do you support SSO?

    Yes, Business and Enterprise plans include SAML 2.0 SSO with just-in-time provisioning.

  • How does Keel perform on large codebases?

    Keel indexes repositories with hundreds of thousands of files and keeps that index up to date as you work.

  • Do you support on-prem or VPC?

    We run on managed cloud infrastructure with enterprise-grade security controls designed to match on-premise expectations.

  • Business or Enterprise?

    If you need more than 250 seats, Enterprise adds dedicated support and custom billing. Otherwise Business has the same features.

  • Can I get security documentation?

    Yes, full documentation is available through our Trust Center and dedicated security FAQ.

  • Are there volume discounts?

    We don't currently offer volume-based pricing outside of annual Business and Enterprise plans.

  • Can admins track usage?

    Admins can view usage information and key adoption metrics through the Admin Dashboard.

  • Where can I ask more questions?

    Email us directly at enterprise@keel.dev and we'll follow up.

name: FAQ — Tarmac
html:
You might be wondering

Does Tarmac support a staging-to-production pipeline?

Yes — we call them PR environments. Every pull request gets its own throwaway deploy that disappears when the PR closes.

Where do I set the size of my deployments?

You don't have to. We scale vertically to match demand automatically; add replicas if you need horizontal scale too.

Can a service run without being exposed to the internet?

Yes. Leave it unattached to a domain and it behaves like an internal worker that only your other services can reach.

How different is Tarmac from the platform I'm using today?

We're not a clone. Read our comparison docs for exactly where we diverge on purpose, and why.

Is there a free trial?

Yes — every new account starts with trial credit. Check our pricing page for the current details.
